title: 3Q26: VEON Delivers Double-Digit Growth as Digital Services Reach 27.2% of Revenue
body_markdown:
06 Nov 2026


#### 3Q26: VEON Delivers Double-Digit Growth as Digital Services Reach 27.2% of Revenue


**VEON raises mid-point of 2026 Revenue and EBITDA outlook**


Key Highlights


-


Total revenue increased 17.2% YoY to USD 1,307 million. Revenue for 9M26 grew 17.1% YoY to USD 3,779 million.


-


EBITDA for the quarter increased 10.1% YoY to USD 577 million. For 9M26, EBITDA grew 11.0% YoY to USD 1,645 million.


-


Digital revenue increased 45.9% YoY to USD 355 million, representing 27.2% of Group revenue, up 5.4 percentage points YoY. Digital EBITDA increased 54.5% YoY to USD 128 million, representing 36.0% EBITDA margin.


-


Group net profit for the quarter reached USD 225 million, of which net profit attributable to VEON shareholders was USD 187 million, representing diluted earnings per ADS of USD 2.67.


-


Free cash flow2 reached USD 201 million in 3Q26 (-33.8% YoY); excluding asset disposal proceeds, FCF grew 91.8%.


-


Mid-point of 2026 guidance raised. Revenue growth outlook now 16%-18% YoY (previously 15%-18%), EBITDA growth outlook now 10%-12% YoY (previously 9% to 12%). Capex intensity (excl. Ukraine) outlook maintained at 15% to 17% of revenues.


-


1.55 million ADSs repurchased (for USD 112.5 million) out of an aggregate 2.9 million ADS buyback program. 1.08 million ADSs (1.5% of issued shares) cancelled effective October 20, 2026. All repurchased shares under program to be cancelled.


**Dubai and New York, Nov 06, 2026** – VEON Ltd. (Nasdaq: VEON) reported results for the third quarter of 2026, delivering 17.2% YoY revenue and 10.1% YoY EBITDA growth and continued expansion of its digital businesses. Digital revenue rose 45.9% YoY, reaching 27.2% of Group revenue, while Digital EBITDA grew 54.5% YoY. On a like-for-like basis, Revenue, EBITDA and profit for the period grew 15.8%, 9.8% and 2.4% respectively for 3Q26, and 16.4%, 12.3% and 25.5% respectively for 9M26.


“VEON delivered another quarter of double-digit growth, and we are raising the midpoint of our full year outlook," **said Kaan Terzioglu, Group CEO of VEON.** "Our telecom business continues to perform, and our digital businesses are becoming more profitable as they scale. Each one makes the other stronger. We look forward to showing how we will keep compounding value for years to come at our Capital Markets Day on November 16."


**Telecom & Infrastructure: Sustainable, steady Growth**


-


Telecommunications and infrastructure revenue grew 9.2% YoY to USD 952 million in 3Q26, with mobile ARPU increasing 4.7% YoY to USD 1.8, reflecting continued disciplined pricing, customer growth and higher data usage.


-


Multiplay customers reached 44.7 million, up 2.9% YoY, and generated 4.2x the ARPU of voice-only users, reinforcing the flywheel between connectivity, digital adoption and revenue growth.
Digital Platform Scaling Profitably, Generating Cash


**Digital Platform Scaling Profitably, Generating Cash**


-


Digital customers reached 221.1 million in 3Q26, up 8.2% YoY, demonstrating the scale of VEON's digital ecosystem.


-


Financial Services revenue grew 54.2% YoY to USD 166 million in 3Q26 and 48.2% YoY to USD 451 million in 9M26. Financial Services customers reached 59.7 million.


-


Digital EBITDA climbed 54.5% YoY to USD 128 million, representing 36.0% EBITDA margin. LTM Capex intensity was 6.9%.


**Strong Cash Generation, Accelerating Capital Returns**


-


-


Cash and cash equivalents stood at USD 2,033 million as of September 30, 2026, including USD 755 million at HQ. Leverage ratio3 stood at 1.05x, with a weighted average debt maturity of 4 years.


-


VEON recently launched a new buyback program to repurchase 3.9% of outstanding shares (represented by 2.9 million ADSs)– this follows USD 200 million in cumulative buybacks since August 2024. A first tranche of 1.08m ADSs (1.5% of outstanding shares) were cancelled effective October 20, 2026 in connection with the buyback program. VEON will cancel all additional shares acquired under the new buyback program.


**Other Significant Developments**


-


Announced acquisition of Perfectum in Uzbekistan: advances industry consolidation and materially strengthens Beeline Uzbekistan’s spectrum portfolio.


-


Progressed collaboration with Starlink: Service launched in Kazakhstan and Bangladesh. Inclusive of Ukraine, the service now has over 13 million subscribers across VEON’s markets.


-


Established VEON’s digital financial services presence in Bangladesh: Secured approval for a digital banking license, while payment services provider Mukto Pay launched operations in November.


-


Signed a five-year memorandum of cooperation with the National Bank of Kazakhstan to explore digital payment services and integration with national payment infrastructure in Kazakhstan.


-


Strengthened Kyivstar's Enterprise Cloud proposition and digital ecosystem significantly with the announced acquisition of GigaCloud.


-


Enhanced long-term IT cost predictability and accelerated Digital Operator model with a 10-year strategic agreement with Amdocs.


-


Diversified and strengthened digital entertainment business with announced Jungo TV transaction.


**VEON is revising up the mid-point of its 2026 outlook**


**Revised** Previous


Revenue Growth (YoY, USD) **16%–18%** 15%–18%


EBITDA Growth (YoY, USD) **10%–12%** 9%–12%


Capex Intensity (excl. Ukraine) **15%-17% (unchanged)** 15%–17%

**About VEON**
VEON is a digital operator that provides converged connectivity and digital services to nearly 152 million connectivity and more than 221 million digital users. Operating across five countries that are home to more than 6% of the world’s population, VEON is transforming lives through technology-driven services that empower individuals and drive economic growth. VEON is listed on NASDAQ. For more information, visit:[https://www.veon.com](https://www.veon.com/) .
